Possibili autonomie alle regioni a statu: Possible autonomies to the regions with ordinary statute are provided for by the third paragraph of article 116 of the Constitution, which underlines how they can be attributed "by state law on the initiative of the region concerned". An article that has never been implemented, above all due to the large economic and social differences between regions, which make the approval of laws in this sense particularly delicate, and potentially harmful. Scholars dispute both the technical aspects and the possible extremely negative social effects capable of increasing inequalities at an inter-regional level and splitting the country in two. This law is strongly supported by the League - Zaia - Calderoli who see greater regional developments in it. Some newspapers have defined it as "the secession of the rich", because it would ensure much more funding for the regions of the North, which already have greater resources than those of the South. According to the bill, there is one year to decide on the essential levels of "so-called Lep" benefits. The trouble lies in the fact that the regions will be able to formulate an agreement even without the Prime Minister's decree which should establish the size of the LEPs, thus distributing the funding based on the historical expenditure of the region in the specific area in which it requests autonomy. But what are the latest regional economic data? Public spending per capita is equal to just under 19,000 euros in Lombardy, around 16,000 in Veneto, while it stops at just over 14,000 in Sicily, in Calabria at 15,000, in Campania at 13,700 euros. Therefore, the financing of greater autonomy prefigures a drain of resources in favor of the economically stronger regions. In summary, the implementing law proposal presented by Calderoli opens the way on the one hand to the fragmentation of the country into semi-independent republics, and on the other to a certain increase in inequalities and territorial gaps, including in particular the structural North-South one. In fact, if there is no substantial equality between regions, the differentiated autonomy, once granted according to the art. 116 of the Constitution (reform of Title V provided for by Constitutional Law no. 3/2001), will be potentially irreversible, since the attribution of these strengthened forms of autonomy must be established with a strengthened law, which, from a substantial point of view, is formulated on the basis of an agreement between the State and the Region concerned, having acquired the opinion of the local authorities concerned, in compliance with the principles set out in the art. 119 of the Constitution on the subject of financial autonomy, while, from a procedural point of view, it is approved by the Chambers with an absolute majority of the members. The attribution of differentiated autonomy has never been fully implemented. This is because the process of determining differentiated autonomy is substantially based on the agreements stipulated between the Government and the requesting Region. Once an agreement has been reached, Parliament cannot modify it, it can only approve it en bloc or reject it. Once the law approving the agreements has been approved, it cannot even be subjected to a repeal referendum. The art. 117 of the Constitution specifies that the "Determination of the Essential Levels of Performance (LEP) concerning the civil and social rights that must be guaranteed throughout the national territory" falls within the exclusive legislative competence of the State. Over twenty years have passed and this function has never been exercised. If the determination of the LEP results in new or greater burdens on public finances, the transfer of functions will be possible only after the legislative provisions for the allocation of financial resources consistent with the planned public finance objectives. Furthermore, if after the date of entry into force of the law approving the agreement, the LEPs with the related financing are modified or additional ones are determined, the Region concerned will be required to comply with them, subject to the review of the relevant resources. However, the allocation of resources is not based on the identification of standard needs, as provided for by the recent provisions regarding the financial autonomy of local authorities, but on historical expenditure with the consequent deresponsibility of the levels of government. If differentiated federalism does not achieve the set goals, the changes will only be possible if both partners, government and Region, agree to reform them. Each Region could, therefore, ask which matters to manage. We will no longer be faced with the delegation of functions of the old Presidential Decree. No. 616/1977, in which the State delegated functions and powers but with actual transfers of power. So, the question is, wouldn't it be more useful to think of a reversible and not irreversible formula?

Ineffective managerial decision no. 568 of 07.31.2020, relating to the award in favor of -OMISSIS-. exclusion -OMISSIS- and award to the second in ranking", with which the manager of the complex operational unit for public works - simple operational unit for cemetery services of the Municipality of Pioltello declared the ineffectiveness of managerial determination no. 568 of 31 July 2020, in the part relating to the awarding of the management service of cemetery services and the supply and installation of marble slabs in favor of the economic operator -OMISSIS- and ordered its exclusion, awarding the contract, lasting 24 months, to the second placed xxx social cooperative company a r.l.;- of the note dated 13 October 2020 from the manager of the public works sector of the Municipality of Pioltello, with which the declaration of ineffectiveness was communicated, issued with resolution no. 756 of 12 October 2020, of the previous determination no. 568 of 31 July 2020; - of the communication of initiation of the aforementioned procedure; - of all further prerequisite, connected and consequential acts, even if unknown; and for compensation for damages resulting from the execution of the illegitimate measures, in a specific form, through the awarding of the contract and relative takeover of the contract, or equivalently, through the compensation of a sum equal to 20% of the offer of the appellant company or a different amount that is deemed fair; as well as for the declaration of the ineffectiveness of the award made in favor of the company xxx social cooperative a r.l. and of the contract possibly pending signed, with the taking over of the appellant company in the same. Having seen the appeal and its attachments; Having seen the documents of appearance in court of the Municipality of Pioltello and of the social cooperative society xxx.; Having seen the request for suspension of the execution of the contested provision, presented incidentally by the appellant; Having seen article 55 c.p.a.; Having seen all the documents of the case; Having established its jurisdiction and competence; Dr. Rosanna Perilli was the speaker in the council chamber on 2 December 2020 and heard, in the discussion carried out remotely using the Microsoft-Teams platform, the lawyer Pilar Sanjust for the appellant and the lawyer Fabio Romanenghi for the Municipality of Pioltello; Having seen the notes of the hearing and the request for passage of the case to a decision, filed by the counter-interested company on 1 December 2020, signed by the lawyer Luigi Ferrara, who, pursuant to articles 25, paragraph 1, of the legislative decree of 28 October 2020 and 4, paragraph 1, of the legislative decree of 30 April 2020, n. 28, is considered present for all purposes at the hearing; The complaints put forward by the appellant are not supported by a sufficient degree of validity, as the Municipality of Pioltello correctly declared the ineffectiveness of the award after having recognised, following the outcome of the procedural cross-examination, the existence of the causes of exclusion referred to in Article 80, paragraph 5, letters c) and c-bis) of Legislative Decree no. 18 April 2016. 50, to which, contrary to what is claimed by the appellant company, the requirement of the finality of the criminal conviction does not apply, provided for the causes of exclusion referred to in paragraph 1 of the same article, and the preclusive effect consequent to the assumption of the binding commitment to pay the taxes due, foreseen for the cause of exclusion referred to in paragraph 4, does not extend. The Board, consistently with the orientation expressed by the Section (T.a.r. Lombardia, Milan, 12 October 2020, n. 1881; 10 August 2020, n. 1538; 15 November 2019, n. 2421), believes that, in application of the principle of all-inclusiveness and reasonable enforceability of the declaration and information obligations towards the contracting authority, the appellant company should have declared the conviction reported by the only two partners of the same non-existent. The Board observes that the aforementioned conviction falls within the qualitative and temporal scope of the declarations required, in fulfillment of the duties of diligence and good faith, by the economic operator, both because it has ascertained the violation, in a fraudulent manner, of the fundamental tax obligations related to the exercise of the business activity, and because the not yet definitive assessment of the serious professional misconduct, capable of influencing the evaluation of the contracting authority with regard to the integrity and reliability requirements of the competitor, despite having as its object criminal acts committed up to 2016, occurred in October 2019 and therefore on a date included in the three-year period preceding the declaration of possession of the participation requirements (Council of State, Meeting of the Special Commission of 23 October 2018, affair no. 1725 of 2018, par 8.8.). In balancing the interests at stake, that of the contracting authority to negotiate with economic operators on which to place full trust must certainly be considered to prevail over the purely patrimonial interest of the appellant company. The precautionary application must therefore be rejected. The costs of the phase follow the defeat and are paid, in favor of the Municipality of Pioltello and the prosecutor of xxx, declared. The Regional Administrative Court for Lombardy (First Section) rejects the precautionary application. It condemns the appellant company to pay, towards the Municipality of Pioltello and the lawyer Luigi Ferrara, anti-state attorney of the social cooperative company xxx, the costs of the precautionary phase, which settles in total 2,000.00 euros (two thousand/00) plus accessories, to be paid at the rate of 1,000.00 euros (one thousand/00) for each party. This order will be executed by the Administration and is filed with the secretariat of the Court which will communicate it to the parties. Considered that the conditions referred to in Article 52, paragraphs 1 and 2, of Legislative Decree no. 30 June 2003 exist. 196, and article 10 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016, to protect the rights or dignity of the interested party, directs the Secretariat to proceed with the blackout of the personal details as well as any other data suitable for identifying the appellant company, its legal representative and its shareholders.
